formats.key: Act(uint256 publicationActedProfileId,uint256 publicationActedId,uint256 actorProfileId,uint256[] referrerProfileIds,uint256[] referrerPubIds,address actionModuleAddress,bytes actionModuleData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Runs the action module `actionModuleAddress` on publication (publicationActedProfileId, publicationActedId) for actorProfileId, with the signer as transactionExecutor (LensHub.actWithSig -> ActionLib.act).
The module can pull the signer's ERC-20 tokens, for example a collect fee whose currency and amount sit in actionModuleData (case 0 encodes USDC and 1,000,000), and can mint a collect NFT.
Referrer profiles and publications can receive a share of that payment.
Uses up one nonce of the signer.
formats.shown: The intent "Act" and three raw profile and publication ids; the module, its data and the referrers are hidden.

findings.title: Act hides the action module and its data, which decide what the signer pays and to whom.
findings.evidence: descriptor Act: {"path":"actionModuleAddress","visible":"never"}, {"path":"actionModuleData","visible":"never"}; LensHub.actWithSig passes transactionExecutor: signature.signer to ActionLib.act; case 0 actionModuleData encodes 0x2791…4174 (USDC) and 0xf4240.
findings.fix: Show actionModuleAddress as an addressName field labelled "Action module". Decode the known collect-module payloads or show actionModuleData with a clear label. Change the intent to "Act on publication (may pay a fee)".

findings.title: Act hides the referrer profiles and publications that can receive part of the payment.
findings.evidence: descriptor Act: referrerProfileIds.[] and referrerPubIds.[] are visible: never; MetaTxLib.validateActSignature signs both arrays.
findings.fix: Show referrerProfileIds.[] and referrerPubIds.[] labelled "Referrer profile" and "Referrer publication".

findings.title: Act uses the bare word "Act" and camelCase raw labels that a normal signer cannot read.
findings.evidence: descriptor Act: "intent": "Act"; labels "actorProfileId", "publicationActedId", "publicationActedProfileId".
findings.fix: Use labels "Acting profile", "Publication author" and "Publication id", and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Act on publication {publicationActedId} of profile {publicationActedProfileId}".

formats.key: ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig(uint256 delegatorProfileId,address[] delegatedExecutors,bool[] approvals,uint64 configNumber,bool switchToGivenConfig,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Sets approved or revoked for each listed executor in executor config number configNumber of the signer's profile.
Approved executors can then post, follow, act and change modules for the profile on the owner's behalf.
When switchToGivenConfig is true, that config becomes the active one; executors of the old active config lose their access.
formats.shown: The raw intent "ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig", the profile id, a list of executor addresses, a separate list of true/false values, the config number, the switch flag and the nonce.

findings.title: ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig shows executors and approvals as two unpaired lists, so a grant cannot be matched to its address.
findings.evidence: case 1 screen: three "Delegated Executors" rows, then three "Approvals" rows "true", "false", "true"; ProfileLib._changeDelegatedExecutorsConfig sets isApproved[configNumber][delegatedExecutors[i]] = approvals[i].
findings.fix: Label the lists "Executor" and "Grant (true) / revoke (false)" and show the executors with addressName. Change the intent to "Grant or revoke profile managers".

findings.title: ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig does not explain that switching config drops every executor of the current config.
findings.evidence: ProfileLib._prepareStorageToApplyChangesUnderGivenConfig: _delegatedExecutorsConfig.configNumber = nextAvailableConfigNumber when switchToGivenConfig; descriptor label "switchToGivenConfig" raw.
findings.fix: Relabel switchToGivenConfig as "Replace current managers with this set" and configNumber as "Manager set number".

findings.title: ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig intent is the raw type name and does not say that profile control is delegated.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "intent": "ChangeDelegatedExecutorsConfig".
findings.fix: Use intent "Change who can manage your Lens profile" and add an interpolatedIntent naming delegatorProfileId.

formats.key: Comment(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256[] referrerProfileIds,uint256[] referrerPubIds,bytes referenceModuleData,address[] actionModules,bytes[] actionModulesInitDatas,address referenceModule,bytes referenceModuleInitData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: Creates a comment by profileId with contentURI on publication (pointedProfileId, pointedPubId).
Runs the pointed publication's reference module processComment with referenceModuleData and the referrers, with the signer as transactionExecutor.
Initializes each action module of actionModules on the new comment with its init data, for example a collect module that sets price and fee recipient.
Initializes referenceModule on the new comment, which decides who can comment, mirror or quote it.
formats.shown: The intent "Comment", the profile id, the content URI, the pointed profile and publication ids and the nonce; all modules, init data and referrers are hidden.

findings.title: Comment hides the action modules and init data installed on the signer's new comment.
findings.evidence: descriptor Comment: actionModules and actionModulesInitDatas visible: never; PublicationLib line 529 calls IPublicationActionModule(params.actionModules[i]).initializePublicationAction(..., params.transactionExecutor, ...); case 2 sets two action modules that the screen does not show.
findings.fix: Show actionModules.[] with addressName labelled "Action module", and show the init data or decode known modules.

findings.title: Comment hides the reference module that controls who can reply to or mirror the new comment.
findings.evidence: descriptor Comment: referenceModule visible: never; PublicationLib line 560 calls IReferenceModule(params.referenceModule).initializeReferenceModule; case 2 sets referenceModule 0xA0b8…eB48.
findings.fix: Show referenceModule with addressName labelled "Reply rules module".

findings.title: Comment hides the referrer ids and referenceModuleData passed to the pointed publication's reference module.
findings.evidence: descriptor Comment: referrerProfileIds, referrerPubIds, referenceModuleData visible: never; PublicationLib._processCommentIfNeeded passes them to processComment.

formats.key: Follow(uint256 followerProfileId,uint256[] idsOfProfilesToFollow,uint256[] followTokenIds,bytes[] datas,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer's profile followerProfileId follows each profile in idsOfProfilesToFollow (LensHub.followWithSig -> FollowLib.follow).
For each profile the follow module of that profile processes the follow with datas[i]; a fee module can take a fee from the signer as transactionExecutor.
followTokenIds[i] = 0 mints a new follow token; another value reuses that existing follow token.
formats.shown: The intent "Follow", the follower id, the profiles to follow, the follow token ids, the module data as hex, the nonce and the expiry date.

findings.title: Follow shows follow-module data as raw hex, so a follow fee in it cannot be read.
findings.evidence: descriptor Follow: {"path":"datas.[]","label":"Follow Module Data","format":"raw"}; LensHub.followWithSig passes datas and transactionExecutor: signature.signer to FollowLib.follow.
findings.fix: Keep the field but label it "Follow module data (may hold a fee)", and say in the intent that a follow can cost a fee.

findings.title: Follow shows followTokenIds 0 literally, but 0 means a new follow token is minted.
findings.evidence: case 3 screen: "Follow Token" "0" twice; descriptor follow token field has format raw.
findings.fix: Label the field "Existing follow token (0 = new)".

findings.title: Follow does not show any follow fee, which the followed profile's module stores.
findings.evidence: LensHub.followWithSig delegates to FollowLib.follow and the follow module; the fee is stored in the module, not in the Follow message.

couldNotCheck: ActionLib.sol is not in the directory. LensHub.actWithSig calls ActionLib.act, and the exact token movements from the signer in Act could not be traced.
FollowLib.sol is not in the directory. LensHub.followWithSig and unfollowWithSig call FollowLib, and any follow fee taken from the signer could not be traced.

The publication action modules and follow modules that LensHub calls (chosen by actionModuleAddress, actionModules and followModule) have no source here, so what they pull from the signer could not be checked.

findings.title: follow_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies, yet the screen presents it as a LensHub follow.
findings.reason: No LensHub function hashes a follow_with_sign struct; MetaTxLib only uses the Typehash constants, and followWithSig checks Typehash.FOLLOW. A signature over this type cannot be verified by LensHub, so it moves none of the signer's assets and grants no right. That makes it a dead or misbound format, not a hidden effect.

findings.format: Quote(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Quote format type differs from the Quote type LensHub verifies; real quotes get no clear signing.
findings.reason: A real 13-member Quote message has a different encodeType, so this 6-member format does not match it, and a 6-member Quote message fails LensHub's QUOTE hash check. The result is missing clear signing for quotes, which is a coverage gap. No effect is hidden or shown differently.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.validateQuoteSignature: `abi.encode(Typehash.QUOTE, ...)` with Typehash.QUOTE = 'Quote(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256[] referrerProfileIds,...)'; descriptor key 'Quote(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)'

findings.title: quote_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies, so the stated quote never happens.
findings.reason: LensHub verifies no quote_with_sign type, so the signature cannot run anything. No asset or right of the signer changes.
findings.quote: Typehash.sol: only QUOTE = 'Quote(...)'; LensHub.quoteWithSig → MetaTxLib.validateQuoteSignature

findings.title: set_block_status is not the SetBlockStatus type LensHub verifies and omits the profiles and statuses.
findings.reason: setBlockStatusWithSig checks only Typehash.SET_BLOCK_STATUS, so a set_block_status signature cannot block or unblock anyone. Leaving out the profiles and statuses hides nothing, because this message has no effect on LensHub.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.validateSetBlockStatusSignature: `abi.encode(Typehash.SET_BLOCK_STATUS, byProfileId, ...)`

findings.title: set_block_status_with_sig is not a type LensHub verifies, yet it is bound to the LensHub domain.
findings.reason: LensHub has no typehash for set_block_status_with_sig, so this signature cannot be used. No asset or right of the signer changes.
findings.quote: Typehash.SET_BLOCK_STATUS = keccak256('SetBlockStatus(uint256 byProfileId,uint256[] idsOfProfilesToSetBlockStatus,bool[] blockStatus,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)')

findings.format: SetFollowModule(uint256 profileId,address followModule,bytes followModuleInitData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: SetFollowModule hides the init data that sets the follow fee and who receives it.
findings.reason: The screen shows the follow module address and the profile. The hidden init data only configures that module, and it moves none of the signer's assets in this call. This is the detail of a shown module (not_critical 13 and 5), so it is a warning at most. The fee semantics also rest on module code that is not in the directory.
findings.quote: descriptor SetFollowModule: {"path":"followModule","label":"followModule","format":"raw"}; ProfileLib._initFollowModule: `IFollowModule(followModule).initializeFollowModule(profileId, transactionExecutor, followModuleInitData)`

findings.title: set_profile_metadata_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies and omits the new metadata.
findings.reason: setProfileMetadataURIWithSig checks only Typehash.SET_PROFILE_METADATA_URI, so this type is never accepted. The real SetProfileMetadataURI format shows metadataURI. The omission hides nothing, because this message has no effect.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.validateSetProfileMetadataURISignature: `abi.encode(Typehash.SET_PROFILE_METADATA_URI, profileId, ...)`; descriptor SetProfileMetadataURI shows `metadataURI`

findings.title: unfollow_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies and omits which profiles are unfollowed.
findings.reason: unfollowWithSig checks only Typehash.UNFOLLOW, so an unfollow_with_sign signature cannot unfollow anyone. The real Unfollow format shows idsOfProfilesToUnfollow.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.validateUnfollowSignature: `abi.encode(Typehash.UNFOLLOW, unfollowerProfileId, ...)`; descriptor Unfollow: {"path":"idsOfProfilesToUnfollow.[]","label":"ids Of Profiles To Unfollow"}

findings.format: Act(uint256 publicationActedProfileId,uint256 publicationActedId,uint256 actorProfileId,uint256[] referrerProfileIds,uint256[] referrerPubIds,address actionModuleAddress,bytes actionModuleData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Act hides the action module and its data, which decide what the signer pays and to whom.
findings.reason: ActionLib and the action module implementation are missing, so the alleged payment cannot be traced. Case 0 contains encoded bytes but no mined effect proving their meaning.
findings.quote: LensHub.sol, actWithSig: `ActionLib.act({ publicationActionParams: publicationActionParams, transactionExecutor: signature.signer, actorProfileOwner: ownerOf(publicationActionParams.actorProfileId) });` descriptor.json, Act: `{"path":"actionModuleAddress","visible":"never"}`, `{"path":"actionModuleData","visible":"never"}`; cases/0.json: `"txHash": null`.

findings.format: Comment(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256[] referrerProfileIds,uint256[] referrerPubIds,bytes referenceModuleData,address[] actionModules,bytes[] actionModulesInitDatas,address referenceModule,bytes referenceModuleInitData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Comment hides the action modules and init data installed on the signer's new comment.
findings.reason: Comment enables the selected action modules on the new publication and passes their initialization data. Neither the enabled modules nor their data appear on screen.
findings.quote: PublicationLib.sol, comment → _createReferencePublication → _initPubActionModules: `StorageLib.getPublication(params.profileId, params.pubId).actionModuleEnabled[params.actionModules[i]] = true;` and `IPublicationActionModule(params.actionModules[i]).initializePublicationAction(params.profileId, params.pubId, params.transactionExecutor, params.actionModulesInitDatas[i]);` descriptor.json, Comment: `{"label":"Action Modules","path":"actionModules","visible":"never"}`, `{"label":"Action Modules Init Datas","path":"actionModulesInitDatas","visible":"never"}`.

findings.title: follow_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies, yet the screen presents it as a LensHub follow.
findings.reason: The unsupported type is a binding defect, but its signature does not authorize the real follow operation. The verifier binds the actual Follow fields and rejects an invalid signature.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.sol, validateFollowSignature: `Typehash.FOLLOW, followerProfileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(idsOfProfilesToFollow), _encodeUsingEip712Rules(followTokenIds), _encodeUsingEip712Rules(datas)`; _validateRecoveredAddress: `if (recoveredAddress == address(0) || recoveredAddress != signature.signer) { revert Errors.SignatureInvalid(); }`.

findings.title: link is not a type LensHub verifies, so the screen states a handle link that LensHub never performs.
findings.reason: The unsupported link format establishes no executable LensHub authorization or hidden change to the signer's rights. A misleading format alone does not establish a critical effect.
findings.quote: descriptor.json, link: `"intent": "link"`; MetaTxLib.sol, _validateRecoveredAddress: `address recoveredAddress = ecrecover(digest, signature.v, signature.r, signature.s);` and `if (recoveredAddress == address(0) || recoveredAddress != signature.signer) { revert Errors.SignatureInvalid(); }`; Typehash.sol contains no link type.

findings.title: link_with_sig is not a type LensHub verifies, yet it is bound to the LensHub domain.
findings.reason: Binding an unsupported type to the domain does not make LensHub accept it. No hidden asset or rights change follows from this format.
findings.quote: descriptor.json, link_with_sig: `"intent": "link_with_sig"`; MetaTxLib.sol, _validateRecoveredAddress: `if (recoveredAddress == address(0) || recoveredAddress != signature.signer) { revert Errors.SignatureInvalid(); }`; Typehash.sol contains no link_with_sig type.

findings.title: mint is not a type LensHub verifies, so the screen states a mint that never happens.
findings.reason: The descriptor's mint type has no corresponding signature authorization path. This is an unsupported format, not evidence of an undisclosed mint or asset change.
findings.quote: descriptor.json, mint: `"intent": "mint"`; LensHub.sol, createProfile: `_mint(createProfileParams.to, profileId);`; MetaTxLib.sol, _validateRecoveredAddress: `if (recoveredAddress == address(0) || recoveredAddress != signature.signer) { revert Errors.SignatureInvalid(); }`; Typehash.sol contains no mint type.

findings.title: mirror_with_sig is not the Mirror type LensHub verifies, so the stated mirror never happens.
findings.reason: The real mirror verifier uses a different signed digest, preventing this unsupported message from authorizing the claimed operation. No hidden effect is demonstrated.
findings.quote: LensHub.sol, mirrorWithSig: `MetaTxLib.validateMirrorSignature(signature, mirrorParams);`; MetaTxLib.sol, validateMirrorSignature: `Typehash.MIRROR, mirrorParams.profileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(mirrorParams.metadataURI)`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.

findings.format: Post(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,address[] actionModules,bytes[] actionModulesInitDatas,address referenceModule,bytes referenceModuleInitData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Post hides the action modules and init data installed on the signer's new post.
findings.reason: Post enables and initializes caller-selected action modules without showing them. This effect is explicit in the code, although case 10's empty arrays do not exercise it.
findings.quote: PublicationLib.sol, post → _initPubActionModules: `StorageLib.getPublication(params.profileId, params.pubId).actionModuleEnabled[params.actionModules[i]] = true;` and `IPublicationActionModule(params.actionModules[i]).initializePublicationAction(params.profileId, params.pubId, params.transactionExecutor, params.actionModulesInitDatas[i]);` descriptor.json, Post: `{"label":"Action Modules","path":"actionModules","visible":"never"}`, `{"label":"Action Modules Init Datas","path":"actionModulesInitDatas","visible":"never"}`.

findings.title: post_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies, yet the screen presents it as a LensHub post.
findings.reason: The real post verifier binds Post and its complete parameters. The unsupported post_with_sign message cannot substitute for that authorization.
findings.quote: LensHub.sol, postWithSig: `MetaTxLib.validatePostSignature(signature, postParams);`; MetaTxLib.sol, validatePostSignature: `Typehash.POST, postParams.profileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(postParams.contentURI), _encodeUsingEip712Rules(postParams.actionModules)`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.

findings.format: Quote(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: Quote format type differs from the Quote type LensHub verifies; real quotes get no clear signing.
findings.reason: The type mismatch is real, but missing clear-signing coverage does not prove a hidden executed effect. The shortened message cannot authorize a quote through the actual verifier.
findings.quote: descriptor.json format: `Quote(uint256 profileId,string contentURI,uint256 pointedProfileId,uint256 pointedPubId,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)`; MetaTxLib.sol, validateQuoteSignature: `Typehash.QUOTE` and `_encodeUsingEip712Rules(quoteParams.actionModules)` are included before `_validateRecoveredAddress(_calculateDigest(keccak256(encodedAbi)), signature);`.

findings.title: quote_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies, so the stated quote never happens.
findings.reason: LensHub verifies the complete Quote type, not quote_with_sign. The unsupported format does not establish an executable hidden authorization.
findings.quote: LensHub.sol, quoteWithSig: `MetaTxLib.validateQuoteSignature(signature, quoteParams);`; MetaTxLib.sol, validateQuoteSignature: `Typehash.QUOTE`; _validateRecoveredAddress: `if (recoveredAddress == address(0) || recoveredAddress != signature.signer) { revert Errors.SignatureInvalid(); }`.

findings.title: set_block_status is not the SetBlockStatus type LensHub verifies and omits the profiles and statuses.
findings.reason: The real verifier binds both profile IDs and block statuses. This shortened, differently named message cannot authorize undisclosed blocking through that verifier.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.sol, validateSetBlockStatusSignature: `Typehash.SET_BLOCK_STATUS, byProfileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(idsOfProfilesToSetBlockStatus), _encodeUsingEip712Rules(blockStatus)`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.

findings.title: set_block_status_with_sig is not a type LensHub verifies, yet it is bound to the LensHub domain.
findings.reason: The domain alone does not authorize a block-status change. LensHub requires a signature over the actual SetBlockStatus type and its arrays.
findings.quote: LensHub.sol, setBlockStatusWithSig: `MetaTxLib.validateSetBlockStatusSignature(signature, byProfileId, idsOfProfilesToSetBlockStatus, blockStatus);`; MetaTxLib.sol, validateSetBlockStatusSignature: `Typehash.SET_BLOCK_STATUS`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.

findings.format: SetFollowModule(uint256 profileId,address followModule,bytes followModuleInitData,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)
findings.title: SetFollowModule hides the init data that sets the follow fee and who receives it.
findings.reason: The module address is shown, but the missing module implementation is needed to establish fee and recipient semantics. The supplied case uses empty initialization data and has no mined effect.
findings.quote: ProfileLib.sol, _initFollowModule: `return IFollowModule(followModule).initializeFollowModule(profileId, transactionExecutor, followModuleInitData);`; descriptor.json, SetFollowModule: `{"path":"followModule","label":"followModule","format":"raw"}`, `{"label":"Follow Module Init Data","path":"followModuleInitData","visible":"never"}`; cases/17.json: `"followModuleInitData": "0x"`, `"txHash": null`.

findings.title: set_profile_metadata_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies and omits the new metadata.
findings.reason: The actual metadata verifier includes the new metadata URI in the signed digest. The unsupported shortened type cannot authorize an undisclosed metadata update.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.sol, validateSetProfileMetadataURISignature: `Typehash.SET_PROFILE_METADATA_URI, profileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(metadataURI), _getNonceIncrementAndEmitEvent(signature.signer), signature.deadline`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.

findings.title: unfollow_with_sign is not a type LensHub verifies and omits which profiles are unfollowed.
findings.reason: The actual Unfollow signature binds the profiles to unfollow. The unsupported shortened message cannot authorize hidden unfollows through this verifier.
findings.quote: MetaTxLib.sol, validateUnfollowSignature: `Typehash.UNFOLLOW, unfollowerProfileId, _encodeUsingEip712Rules(idsOfProfilesToUnfollow), _getNonceIncrementAndEmitEvent(signature.signer), signature.deadline`; _validateRecoveredAddress rejects a mismatched recovered signer with `revert Errors.SignatureInvalid();`.
